_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sites" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "association_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entered_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "observed_by" TEXT NULL, "created_at_device" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "server_received_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "sync_error" TEXT NULL, "updated_at_device" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "location_note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_meta" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "people" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "association_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entered_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "observed_by" TEXT NULL, "created_at_device" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "server_received_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "sync_error" TEXT NULL, "updated_at_device" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ponds" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "association_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entered_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "observed_by" TEXT NULL, "created_at_device" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "server_received_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "sync_error" TEXT NULL, "updated_at_device" TEXT NOT NULL, "site_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "code" TEXT NOT NULL, "colour" TEXT NOT NULL, "structure" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'earth', "role" TEXT NOT NULL, "water_supply" TEXT NULL, "length_m" REAL NULL, "width_m" REAL NULL, "surface_m2_override" REAL NULL, "depth_inlet_m" REAL NULL, "depth_outlet_m" REAL NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'empty', "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "batches" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "association_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entered_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "observed_by" TEXT NULL, "created_at_device" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "server_received_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "sync_error" TEXT NULL, "updated_at_device" TEXT NOT NULL, "site_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "code" TEXT NOT NULL, "strain" TEXT NULL, "hatchery" TEXT NULL, "certificate_no" TEXT NULL, "monosex" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("monosex" IN (0, 1)), "planned_harvest_on" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "stockings" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "association_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entered_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "observed_by" TEXT NULL, "created_at_device" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "server_received_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "sync_error" TEXT NULL, "recorded_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "supersedes_id" TEXT NULL, "is_tombstone" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_tombstone" IN (0, 1)), "batch_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "pond_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "avg_weight_mg" INTEGER NOT NULL, "acclimatised" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("acclimatised" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transfers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "association_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entered_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "observed_by" TEXT NULL, "created_at_device" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "server_received_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "sync_error" TEXT NULL, "recorded_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "supersedes_id" TEXT NULL, "is_tombstone" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_tombstone" IN (0, 1)), "batch_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "from_pond_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "to_pond_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "avg_weight_mg" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "daily_logs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "association_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entered_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "observed_by" TEXT NULL, "created_at_device" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "server_received_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "sync_error" TEXT NULL, "recorded_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "supersedes_id" TEXT NULL, "is_tombstone" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_tombstone" IN (0, 1)), "visit_id" TEXT NULL, "pond_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "feed_given_g" INTEGER NOT NULL, "feed_lot_id" TEXT NULL, "feedings" INTEGER NULL, "leftover" TEXT NULL, "ate_fast" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("ate_fast" IN (0, 1)), "deaths" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "death_signs" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "warning_signs" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "water_colour" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "water_readings" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "association_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entered_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "observed_by" TEXT NULL, "created_at_device" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "server_received_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "sync_error" TEXT NULL, "recorded_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "supersedes_id" TEXT NULL, "is_tombstone" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_tombstone" IN (0, 1)), "visit_id" TEXT NULL, "pond_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "temperature_c" REAL NULL, "ph" REAL NULL, "oxygen_mg_l" REAL NULL, "colour" TEXT NULL, "renewed_pct" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "samples" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "association_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entered_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "observed_by" TEXT NULL, "created_at_device" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "server_received_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "sync_error" TEXT NULL, "recorded_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "supersedes_id" TEXT NULL, "is_tombstone" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_tombstone" IN (0, 1)), "visit_id" TEXT NULL, "batch_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "pond_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "fish_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "total_weight_g" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "observations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "association_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entered_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "observed_by" TEXT NULL, "created_at_device" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "server_received_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "sync_error" TEXT NULL, "recorded_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "supersedes_id" TEXT NULL, "is_tombstone" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_tombstone" IN (0, 1)), "visit_id" TEXT NULL, "site_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "pond_id" TEXT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "ok" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("ok" IN (0, 1)), "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "health_events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "association_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entered_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "observed_by" TEXT NULL, "created_at_device" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "server_received_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "sync_error" TEXT NULL, "recorded_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "supersedes_id" TEXT NULL, "is_tombstone" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_tombstone" IN (0, 1)), "visit_id" TEXT NULL, "pond_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "signs" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "suspected_issue" TEXT NULL, "actions" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "treatments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "association_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entered_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "observed_by" TEXT NULL, "created_at_device" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "server_received_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "sync_error" TEXT NULL, "recorded_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "supersedes_id" TEXT NULL, "is_tombstone" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_tombstone" IN (0, 1)), "visit_id" TEXT NULL, "pond_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "batch_id" TEXT NULL, "product" TEXT NOT NULL, "dose" TEXT NOT NULL, "advised_by" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "visits" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "association_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entered_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "observed_by" TEXT NULL, "created_at_device" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "server_received_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "sync_error" TEXT NULL, "updated_at_device" TEXT NOT NULL, "site_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "started_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "ended_at" TEXT NULL, "summary" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "groups" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "association_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entered_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "observed_by" TEXT NULL, "created_at_device" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "server_received_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "sync_error" TEXT NULL, "updated_at_device" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "members" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "association_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entered_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "observed_by" TEXT NULL, "created_at_device" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "server_received_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "sync_error" TEXT NULL, "updated_at_device" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "group_id" TEXT NULL, "person_id" TEXT NULL, "role" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_admin" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_admin" IN (0, 1)), "is_sales" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_sales" IN (0, 1)), "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), "locale" TEXT NOT NULL, "login" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "setting_overrides" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "association_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entered_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "observed_by" TEXT NULL, "created_at_device" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "server_received_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "sync_error" TEXT NULL, "updated_at_device" TEXT NOT NULL, "site_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" REAL NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "visit_reports" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "association_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entered_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "observed_by" TEXT NULL, "created_at_device" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "server_received_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "sync_error" TEXT NULL, "recorded_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "supersedes_id" TEXT NULL, "is_tombstone" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_tombstone" IN (0, 1)), "visit_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "site_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "period_from" TEXT NOT NULL, "period_to" TEXT NOT NULL, "content" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "photos" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "association_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entered_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "observed_by" TEXT NULL, "created_at_device" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "server_received_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "sync_error" TEXT NULL, "recorded_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "supersedes_id" TEXT NULL, "is_tombstone" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_tombstone" IN (0, 1)), "owner_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "photo_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "upload" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("upload" IN (0, 1)), "bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "report_reads" ("report_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "read_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("report_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "photo_uploads" ("photo_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "uploaded_at" TEXT NULL, "error" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("photo_key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "prep_steps" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "association_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entered_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "observed_by" TEXT NULL, "created_at_device" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "server_received_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "sync_error" TEXT NULL, "recorded_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "supersedes_id" TEXT NULL, "is_tombstone" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_tombstone" IN (0, 1)), "pond_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "step" TEXT NOT NULL, "product" TEXT NULL, "dose_g" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "feed_deliveries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "association_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entered_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "observed_by" TEXT NULL, "created_at_device" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "server_received_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "sync_error" TEXT NULL, "recorded_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "supersedes_id" TEXT NULL, "is_tombstone" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_tombstone" IN (0, 1)), "site_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "phase" TEXT NOT NULL, "pellet_mm" REAL NULL, "protein_pct" REAL NULL, "weight_g" INTEGER NOT NULL, "manufactured_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "supplier" TEXT NULL, "label" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "feed_discards" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "association_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entered_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "observed_by" TEXT NULL, "created_at_device" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "server_received_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "sync_error" TEXT NULL, "recorded_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "supersedes_id" TEXT NULL, "is_tombstone" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_tombstone" IN (0, 1)), "lot_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "weight_g" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reason" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "harvests" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "association_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entered_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "observed_by" TEXT NULL, "created_at_device" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "server_received_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "sync_error" TEXT NULL, "recorded_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "supersedes_id" TEXT NULL, "is_tombstone" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_tombstone" IN (0, 1)), "batch_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "pond_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "weight_g" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_final" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_final" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sales" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "association_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entered_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "observed_by" TEXT NULL, "created_at_device" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "server_received_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "sync_error" TEXT NULL, "recorded_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "supersedes_id" TEXT NULL, "is_tombstone" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_tombstone" IN (0, 1)), "harvest_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "batch_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "customer_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "weight_g" INTEGER NOT NULL, "form" TEXT NOT NULL, "delivery_note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "customers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "association_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entered_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "observed_by" TEXT NULL, "created_at_device" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "server_received_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "sync_error" TEXT NULL, "updated_at_device" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "contact" TEXT NULL, "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
